title: the tree tool's proof reads deposit_orient's leaf where codemother now puts it, and drops it
intention: The tree tool's proof deposits through codemother's deposit_orient into a codemother-owned scratch nexus, reads the leaf there, and drops it at close, so the proof is green again and leaves no table behind.

why.lived: Charting d23ca0e54d00, its behaviour guard ran the tree tool's proofs: test_chart_tree.py red at HEAD after 2b3d842bc118 moved codemother's orient to her own tables.

measured.saw: test_deposit_back_lands_and_dedups: AssertionError 'a leaf must land in the nexus's table'; the other ten teeth PASS
three codemother_orient_<pid>_..._nodes tables (pids 472333, 472453, 472578) left in Postgres by three runs of the proof
measured.how: select tablename from pg_tables where tablename ~ '^(codemother|chart)_.*orient'

traces_to: Law 8 (a red proof leaned on is worse than none); Law 6 (the leaf lands in the owner's table and the proof reads it there); RULE 1 (the fix lives in the tree tool's own proof).
how: In cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py: an _orient_nexus() helper mints scratch_nexus('orient', owner='codemother') on the same ExitStack and holds (name, owner); the two teeth that call deposit_orient pass nexus=_orient_nexus() and read its table and tree_state with owner 'codemother'; the close forgets each held leaf under its own owner; a new tooth asserts the orient leaf table is owned by 'codemother' and registered as scratch.

clauses.claim: cairn/tools/tree/proofs/test_chart_tree.py runs green: every tooth, including test_deposit_back_lands_and_dedups
the leaf table deposit_orient writes during the run is owned by 'codemother' and is a registered scratch table (store.is_scratch), so it cannot outlive the run

decisions.text: D1: red-first: add PROVES['a229f01ed699'] = {'1': 'test_deposit_back_lands_and_dedups', '2': 'test_the_orient_leaf_is_codemothers_scratch'} and the new tooth (red at HEAD: deposit_orient's leaf is not a scratch table), committed before BUILDME.

D2: _orient_nexus() via scratch_nexus('orient', owner=ORIENT_OWNER) where ORIENT_OWNER = 'codemother'; _HELD holds (name, owner) pairs; test_gate_before_seed's before/after tree_state and control deposit, and test_deposit_back_lands_and_dedups, use the orient nexus and owner; the finally forgets nexus_table(name, owner=owner) for each held pair.

out: the leaked tables of earlier runs
